items.say_when: Getting someone's attention, or a light apology.
sources: CARLA, Univ. of Minnesota (archive.carla.umn.edu): すみません 'excuse me' — getting attention
Portland State Univ. textbook Beginning Japanese for Professionals (pdx.edu): すみません thank you, I'm sorry — checked 2026-10-20

items.jp: ありがとうございます
items.kana: ありがとうございます

items.say_when: Pointing at an item you want.

items.jp: もう一度お願いします
items.kana: もういちどおねがいします
items.say_when: You did not catch what was said. Keeps the conversation going instead of freezing.

items.jp: ゆっくり話してください
items.kana: ゆっくりはなしてください

items.say_when: Point and ask when you do not know a word.

items.romaji: ~ wa nihongo de nan desu ka
items.say_when: Stuck on a word? Say the English word in the slot.

items.jp: 水筒にお水を入れてもらえますか
items.kana: すいとうにおみずをいれてもらえますか
items.romaji: suitō ni omizu o irete moraemasu ka
items.en: could you fill my water bottle with water?
items.note: Believed natural and polite, but ask a native speaker or find a trusted source before promoting to verified.

items.jp: お手洗いはどこですか
items.kana: おてあらいはどこですか
sources: Tatoeba example sentence 'Where's the washroom?' shown on tangorin.com (CC BY 2.0); お手洗い per JMdict — checked 2026-10-20

items.jp: ここで召し上がりますか、それともお持ち帰りですか
items.kana: ここでめしあがりますか、それともおもちかえりですか
items.romaji: koko de meshiagarimasu ka, soretomo omochikaeri desu ka
items.en: is it for here, or to go?
sources: Tatoeba example sentence via japandict.com (JMdict 1770030 entry) — checked 2026-10-20
items.say_when: Listening practice: a polite question you may hear at a counter.
